title: Shyam Singh’s Camp Becomes a Model of Khalsa Fellowship

blocks.text: The page first dwells on the social discipline of Shyam Singh's camp. Those Singhs who travelled from the Majha region were received as honored guests, and Never would a Singh eat alone while companions or travelers remained to be served.

From that ethic of hospitality the narrative moves into wider political change. After the divisions of the Panth and the rise of Kapoor Singh, the circle around Shyam Singh expands into a stronger armed following with noted chiefs, retainers, and a growing mounted force.

The page therefore marks a transition from household virtue to institutional power. What begins as an account of shared food and open welcome becomes the story of a misl taking recognisable military shape under trusted leadership.
